curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds (/s/, /l/, /i /, /p/) in a text

mission.title: identify words with the sounds (/s/, /l/, /i /, /p/) in a text

interactions.prompt: Tap the word that starts with /s/.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Listen in your mind: ‘Lina lifts a lid.’ Which sound begins Lina, lifts and lid?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Lina, lifts and lid begin with /l/.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its sound.
interactions.feedback: Sound star! Every word is with its first sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say the first sound of each word aloud.

interactions.prompt: Read: ‘Pili sees a small pot.’ Which word begins with /p/?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for a small puff of air at the start.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to the sound it begins with.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then tap its first sound.
interactions.retryHint: Focus on only the first sound in each word.

interactions.prompt: Read: ‘I pack lunch and sit.’ Which list shows words beginning with the target sounds?
interactions.feedback: Mission complete! You found /i/, /p/, /l/ and /s/ words.
interactions.retryHint: Look for one word beginning with each target sound.
